decisions.reason: The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already captures the accepted Sales Navigator-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer path, automatic HubSpot export, and arrival time. Email enrichment remains owned by the source Requirement, so no additional candidate update is required.
The accepted automatic email-enrichment workflow does not change whether LinkedIn profile URLs are included or Sales Navigator-specific URLs are excluded.
The source decision concerns automatic email enrichment and export after saving leads in Apollo; it does not resolve or change how existing CRM records are indicated.
The accepted Apollo-to-HubSpot enrichment workflow does not alter the separate, deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
Email information added through Apollo enrichment is distinct from displaying email and LinkedIn chat history in HubSpot lead records.
The source decision specifies enrichment behavior after leads are saved in Apollo but does not change the requirement that the Apollo account be configured.
The candidate deliverable maps MeetAlfred-to-HubSpot flow, while the source decision concerns Sales Navigator-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot enrichment and does not necessarily revise that map.
Automatic Apollo enrichment does not change HubSpot list creation for dead leads or other lead categories.
The source decision does not change HubSpot classification mechanisms such as custom properties, tags, stages, or categories.
The accepted enrichment workflow has no necessary effect on inclusion of lead notes in HubSpot.
Automatically enriching and exporting Apollo leads does not change the separate HubSpot lead-nurturing workflow requirement.
The source decision does not alter the HubSpot lead task-assignment capability.
